name: secure-exam-platform
description: Secure Examination Management and Delivery Platform — client-presentable proof of concept

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sep/shared && npm run build --workspace @sep/activation && npm run build --workspace @sep/api && npm run build --workspace @sep/web
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build --workspace @sep/shared && npm run build --workspace @sep/web
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sep/activation && npm run test --workspace @sep/api && npm run test --workspace @sep/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sep/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @sep/activation && npm run typecheck --workspace @sep/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @sep/web
